name: agend-sh
tagline: Give Cline a persistent Linux workspace with interactive terminals and live previews.
description:
Agend connects Cline to persistent, isolated Linux environments backed by Firecracker microVMs. Run shell commands and background tasks, drive REPLs and terminal apps through a PTY, transfer files, and share services through public HTTPS previews. Interactive terminal responses report input-wait events, helping an agent decide when to send its next input.

The local stdio server is included in the MIT-licensed [Agend CLI](https://github.com/agend-sh/cli); commands execute in your remote Agend environment. An [Agend account](https://agend.sh/account?signup=1) and available environment quota are required. See [pricing and trial limits](https://agend.sh/pricing).

install.notes: Install the Agend CLI using its README quick start, then run `agend login` in the same OS and user account as Cline. The server reads the CLI's saved credentials; no API key belongs in the install command. Make sure `agend` is on Cline's PATH, and select or create an environment within your account quota. The catalog command registers a stdio server in Cline CLI. For the Cline VS Code extension, use `agend config cline` instead, then reload its MCP integration. Installation and account setup: https://github.com/agend-sh/cli#quick-start
